tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The UltraNet Fiber Ethernet Media Converter 100Base (Pair) is a reliable and cost-effective solution for extending your network over long distances using fiber-optic cabling. Designed for seamless copper-to-fiber conversion, this pair of media converters supports 10/100Mbps Fast Ethernet, delivering stable, interference-free data transmission for home, office, ISP, CCTV, and enterprise networks.


With support for 100Base-TX to 100Base-FX, the UltraNet converter ensures smooth connectivity between RJ45 Ethernet devices and fiber backbone networks. Its plug-and-play design, auto-negotiation, and built-in diagnostics make installation quick and hassle-free. Ideal for long-distance links, FTTH/FTTB setups, and noise-free communication, this UltraNet media converter pair is one of the most dependable solutions available in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Supports IEEE 802.3 / 802.3u Fast Ethernet standards
  • Converts 10/100Base-TX (RJ45) to 100Base-FX (Fiber)
  • Auto-negotiation for 10/100Mbps and Full/Half-Duplex
  • Auto MDI/MDI-X crossover on RJ45 port
  • Stable fiber transmission up to multiple kilometers (depending on SM/MM type)
  • LED indicators for Power, TX, RX & Link status
  • Compact metal casing for durability and heat dissipation
  • Plug-and-play operation — no configuration required
  • Ideal for long-distance networking, CCTV, ISP backbone & FTTH networks
